bindings.caption: TOPSe solution is injected into the cadmium precursor solution. temperature: 300 °C. duration: 2 min. Recipe-level reported vessel: three-neck round-bottom flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

CdSe nanocrystals are precipitated with hexane and ethanol. Recipe-level reported vessel: three-neck round-bottom flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

CdSe nanocrystals are washed with ethanol. Recipe-level reported vessel: three-neck round-bottom flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

CdSe nanocrystals are redispersed in toluene. Recipe-level reported vessel: three-neck round-bottom flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

CdSe nanocrystals are centrifuged to remove sludge. Recipe-level reported vessel: three-neck round-bottom flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

CdSe cores are precipitated with ethanol. Recipe-level reported vessel: three-neck round-bottom flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

CdSe/CdxZn1-xS core-shell QDs are precipitated with ethanol. Recipe-level reported vessel: three-neck round-bottom flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

CdSe/CdxZn1-xS core-shell QDs are redispersed in toluene for silanizat. Recipe-level reported vessel: three-neck round-bottom flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Silanized QDs are redispersed in stock solution. Recipe-level reported vessel: three-neck round-bottom flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

SiO2-coated QDs are washed with ethanol. Recipe-level reported vessel: three-neck round-bottom flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

SiO2-coated QDs are redispersed in water. Recipe-level reported vessel: three-neck round-bottom flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.
